main_text.head: PARALLELUM II.
main_text.p: In Parallelo fecundo fcribit Harfcher in quàm varias fectas Reformati fint diftincti, & numerat ultrà centum. In tertio verò parallelo tractat, quâ ratione iidem reformati vel fe mutuò infectentur, vel inter fe confentiant.

Revera Jefuitæ meras fabulas fcribunt, quod eò maiori cum audacia faciunt, quia laici in papatu puri sunt pythagorici, quorum summa lex est: digito compesce labellum: coguntur enim vel inviti credere quidquid hi Magiftri præits predicant. Nam si fides divina (definiente Canisio) est quâ creditur, quod ecclesia Romana proponit, sive id in scriptura sacra expresse extet, sive non. Cur, non fides humana Pontificia, definiretur quòd sit, quâ creditur quod proponunt ac scribunt Jesuitæ sive verum sit, sive falsum? Quòd

page.notes: The line "pythagorici" is printed as shown; "laici in papatu" has a printed star after laici. The word "præditicant" in the source reads "praedicant"; the transcription above follows the visible text, with "hi Magiftri" set as printed. Several words near the lower right are partly obscured by the page curl and are uncertain. The rule above the heading is an ornament, not text.
